description: This is a PHP unit test class for the MatcherRewardRepository component, testing its CRUD operations and behavior related to matcher-reward relationships within the Goteo project.

classes.name: MatcherRewardRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the MatcherRewardRepository class methods and behaviors.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before any tests are run, setting up the repository, matcher, and reward objects.

methods.name: testCountZeroWhenMatcherDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that the count method returns zero when the matcher does not have any associated rewards.

methods.name: testGetListEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the getListByMatcher method returns an empty list when no rewards are associated.

methods.name: testPersist
methods.description: Creates and persists a MatcherReward, then verifies the count reflects the new record.

methods.name: testGetListByMatcher
methods.description: Verifies that getListByMatcher returns correct data after persistence.

methods.name: testGetListByMatcherAndProject
methods.description: Checks that getListByMatcherAndProject returns correct data associated with the project.

methods.name: testExists
methods.description: Confirms that the repository correctly identifies the existence of a matcher-reward pairing.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes a MatcherReward and verifies that the count updates accordingly.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up test data after all tests have run.
